title: New recycling rules
instructions: Belediye yeni geri dönüşüm kurallarını duyuruyor. Kutu renklerini, günleri ve kuralları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: From the first of next month, the city has new rules for recycling.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Every home will get three bins. The blue bin is for paper and cardboard.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: The green bin is for glass bottles and jars. The black bin is for everything else.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Plastic bottles now go in the blue bin with the paper, not in the black bin.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: The blue and green bins will be collected every Tuesday. The black bin will be collected every other Friday.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Please don't put food in any of the bins. You can get a free food box from the city council website.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: If you put things in the wrong bin, we will not collect it.

questions.prompt: When do the new rules start?
options: on the first of next month
questions.feedback: Yeni kurallar gelecek ayın birinde başlıyor.
questions.evidence: From the first of next month

questions.prompt: What goes in the green bin?
questions.feedback: Yeşil kutu cam şişe ve kavanozlar için.
questions.evidence: The green bin is for glass bottles and jars.

questions.prompt: Where do plastic bottles go now?
questions.feedback: Plastik şişeler artık siyah değil, mavi kutuya kâğıtla birlikte.
questions.evidence: Plastic bottles now go in the blue bin with the paper

questions.prompt: How often is the black bin collected?
questions.feedback: Siyah kutu iki cumada bir toplanıyor.
questions.evidence: The black bin will be collected every other Friday.

questions.prompt: What happens if you put things in the wrong bin?
